verdict.line: You lose if you throw E (Judgment) into an unused Riposte or grind an extended duel where she stacks vitals; you win when you silence-into-spin and let Mortal Reminder shut off her sustain from level 12 on.

brief.thesis: This is genuinely even on paper (48.9% win rate over 401 games) but plays out as a sequencing puzzle: her W (Riposte) can block and disarm any ability she sees coming, which is exactly the OP.GG warning about not letting her block your kit. Garen's own Q (Decisive Strike) silences her, and a silenced champion cannot activate Riposte — so every real trade should open Q into E, never E first. Outside that window Fiora holds the edge in prolonged 1v1s because her passive (Duelist's Dance) stacks true damage and healing off revealed vitals, which lines up with her measured solo-kill advantage.

theirWindow.what: If you throw out a raw E (Judgment) or engage with Q first-hit exposed, she flashes W up mid-animation, blocks the tick, disarms you for about 1.3s and hits back — that disarm kills your auto-attack damage and your only sustain source for the rest of the trade. Don't commit E until you've either baited the parry on something else or already silenced her.

yourWindow.what: Silence locks out ability activation, so Fiora physically cannot Riposte while it's up. Land Q, then immediately chain into E (Judgment) — this is the one window where you get to spin freely and stack Perseverance regen without fear of the parry.

start.why: Runs in 55.7% of games at 51.3% win rate — the extra sustain and damage reduction on the first hit of every attack blunts Fiora's early auto-reset poke while you look for silence-into-spin windows.

boots.why: The default 71% pick — the attack speed feeds Stridebreaker procs and lets you land more autos inside your silence window before she can reset with W.

core.why: Closes the gap on her dash-heavy kit and the Ravenous Hydra slow keeps you attached through her Q (Lunge) so she can't kite the spin.

runes.keystoneWhy: Stacks over sustained autos and heals for a percentage of the damage dealt, which matches how this lane is actually won — grinding out extended trades once your Mortal Reminder is up, not one burst window.

summoners.why: 95.5% pick rate for a reason — Ignite's Grievous Wounds stacks with your later Mortal Reminder to shut down her vital-proc healing, and it converts a landed Q-silence-into-E trade into an actual kill threat instead of just a shove.

playing.title: Silence before you spin
playing.detail: Never open a trade with a raw E (Judgment). Land Q (Decisive Strike) first — the silence prevents her from activating W (Riposte) during your spin, so this is the only sequence that guarantees your damage lands.

playing.title: Punish a whiffed Riposte immediately
playing.detail: Once she's used W on a skillshot bait or a minion, it's down for roughly 20+ seconds early — that's your green light to E freely and all-in.

playing.title: Disengage before a vitals proc
playing.detail: If she's landed enough hits to reveal a vital spot, back off before her next auto or ability lines up on it — that hit gives her true damage, a heal, and cooldown refunds that snowball the fight.

playing.title: Keep pre-6 trades short
playing.detail: Her solo-kill advantage comes from winning extended fights, not short pokes. Trade with Q-auto-E once, then reset rather than channeling a full fight before level 6.

playing.title: Rush the Mortal Reminder path
playing.detail: Follow Stridebreaker into Phantom Dancer into Mortal Reminder (58.6% win rate over this exact order) — her sustained duel identity collapses once Grievous Wounds is online.

playing.title: Save R for a locked animation
playing.detail: Demacian Justice can't be parried once cast, but she can still disengage before it — throw it when she's mid-Riposte or mid-ultimate and can't dash away, not on cooldown as a poke.

brief.patchCaveat: The build, runes, summoners, and win rates above are pulled directly from measured Garen vs Fiora games on the current patch (401 games, 48.9% win rate); the sequencing and timing reasoning — silence-locks-Riposte, vitals windows, trade length — is my own read of the kits, not part of the OP.GG data.

stats.opponentTip: Do not let Fiora block your abilities with her Riposte(W). Be careful of her (P) while using your skills to deal damage whenever they come off cooldown.
